statement.en: Support standard macOS mouse and trackpad interactions with their documented behavior.
statement.ja: standard macOS mouse・trackpad interactionを記載されたbehaviorでsupportする。

conditions: Mouse and trackpad: primary click selects; secondary click opens context; scroll moves content; smart zoom and page or full-screen swipes navigate.
Mouse and trackpad: Mission Control activates; trackpad lookup shows data; tap to click performs primary click; force click shows Quick Look or pressure control.
Trackpad pinch zooms; two-finger rotation rotates; edge swipe opens Notification Center; downward swipe opens App Exposé.
Trackpad thumb-and-three-finger pinch opens Launchpad; spreading them reveals the desktop.

statement.en: Keep supported macOS mouse and trackpad interactions consistent with their documented behavior.
statement.ja: 対応するmacOSのmouse・trackpad interactionは、記載された動作と一貫させる。

conditions: The page describes expected system interactions, not a requirement to implement every listed system action in an app. People can customize secondary clicks and gestures and can often disable nonprimary interactions.
For mouse and trackpad, primary click selects or activates; secondary click reveals context menus; scrolling moves content; smart zoom zooms in or out; page and full-screen swipes navigate.
Mission Control uses the documented mouse or trackpad gesture. Trackpad lookup displays a lookup window, and tap-to-click performs a primary click.
On a supported trackpad, force click can display Quick Look or lookup; varying pressure affects pressure-sensitive controls.
Trackpad pinch zooms; two-finger rotation rotates; edge swipe opens Notification Center; downward swipe opens App Exposé.
The page maps a thumb-and-three-finger pinch to Launchpad and spreading those fingers to showing the desktop.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Treat the table as applicable system behavior with user customization, not universal app implementation obligations. Restore select-or-activate, zoom, and distinct force-click/pressure outcomes. Align retrieval modalities/tags with the explicit interaction context.

statement.en: Use each standard macOS pointer style only for its documented interactive meaning.
statement.ja: 各standard macOS pointer styleを記載されたinteractive meaningに合わせて使う。

conditions: Arrow selects; closed or open hand repositions; contextual-menu and pointing-hand pointers indicate menu and link availability.
Crosshair selects precisely; disappearing-item, drag-copy, and drag-link pointers communicate drag results.
Horizontal or vertical I-beam indicates matching text insertion; operation-not-allowed rejects a drop.
Directional resize pointers communicate down, left, left-right, right, up, or up-down resizing.

statement.en: When using a standard macOS pointer style, match its documented interactive meaning.
statement.ja: standard macOS pointer styleを使う場合は、記載されたinteractionの意味に合わせる。

conditions: Standard pointer styles can communicate an element's interactive state or the result of a drag operation; the app does not need to use every style.
An arrow indicates selection and other interactions with content or controls; an open hand indicates that repositioning is possible, while a closed hand indicates dragging to reposition content.
Contextual-menu and pointing-hand pointers indicate menu and link availability; the contextual-menu pointer is generally shown with the Control key.

Crosshair indicates precise rectangular selection. Disappearing-item, drag-copy, and drag-link pointers communicate distinct drop outcomes; the original is unaffected by removing a reference or creating an alias.
Drag-copy appears with Option; drag-link appears with Option and Command. Horizontal or vertical I-beam indicates both text selection and insertion in the matching layout.
Operation-not-allowed indicates that an item cannot be dropped at the location. Directional resize pointers indicate resizing or moving in the documented direction.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Condition the rule on choosing a standard pointer. Preserve possible-versus-in-progress hand states, selection and insertion, and resize-or-move semantics rather than conflating the table entries. Align retrieval modalities/tags with the explicit interaction context.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0001.title: Respond consistently to mouse and trackpad gestures

statement.en: Respond to familiar mouse and trackpad gestures consistently with system expectations.
statement.ja: 使い慣れたmouseとtrackpad gestureへsystemの期待と一貫して応答する。

conditions: For example, Swipe between pages behaves consistently across documents, webpages, and images.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0001.review_note: Repaired the generic statement and recorded the cross-content consistency example.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0002.title: Avoid redefining systemwide trackpad gestures

statement.en: Avoid redefining systemwide trackpad gestures, including in games with custom gestures.
statement.ja: custom gestureを使うgameを含め、systemwide trackpad gestureを再定義しない。

conditions: Keep gestures for the Dock, Mission Control, and other system actions available.
Account for user-customized system gesture settings.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0002.review_note: Recorded the game scope, system examples, and customizable-gesture constraint.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0003.title: Keep interactions consistent across input methods

statement.en: Keep the app experience consistent across gestures, gaze, pointing devices, and keyboards.
statement.ja: gesture、gaze、pointing device、keyboard間でapp体験を一貫させる。

conditions: Let people move fluidly between input types without learning separate interaction models.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0003.review_note: Repaired the truncated statement and preserved every named input method.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0005.title: Keep modifier-key interactions consistent

statement.en: Keep object interactions consistent while a person holds a modifier key.
statement.ja: modifier keyを押している間のobject interactionを一貫させる。

conditions: Option-drag duplication is a representative modifier-key interaction.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0005.review_note: Separated general modifier-key consistency from the explicit touch-and-pointer equality requirement.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0006.title: Support pointer multiple selection in custom iPadOS views

statement.en: When needed, support pointer-based multiple selection in custom iPadOS views.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はcustom iPadOS viewでpointerによるmultiple selectionをsupportする。

conditions: In iPadOS 15 and later, click-and-drag expands the pointer into a rectangular selection region.
Standard nonlist collection views support this by default; custom views require implementation.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0006.review_note: Recorded OS availability, selection behavior, and the custom-view implementation boundary.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0007.title: Differentiate pointer and touch only when valuable

statement.en: Differentiate iPadOS pointer and touch input only when the distinction adds value.
statement.ja: 価値が加わる場合にだけiPadOSのpointerとtouch inputを区別する。

conditions: A video scrubber can offer precise pointer seeking while retaining touch dragging.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0007.review_note: Recorded the value gate and the precision-without-replacement example.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0008.title: Use clear, simple pointer-accessory images

statement.en: Use clear, simple images for custom iPadOS pointer accessories.
statement.ja: custom iPadOS pointer accessoryには明確でsimpleなimageを使う。

conditions: The small image must communicate the interaction without excessive detail.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0008.review_note: Recorded the accessory size and communication constraint.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0009.title: Consider accessory transitions for state changes

statement.en: Consider using an iPadOS pointer-accessory transition to communicate an element’s state or behavior change.
statement.ja: elementのstateやbehavior変化を伝えるためiPadOS pointer accessory transitionを検討する。

conditions: The system animates accessory appearance, disappearance, shape, and position transitions.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0009.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the complete transition behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0011.title: Create contiguous hit regions for custom bar buttons

statement.en: Create contiguous iPadOS hit regions for adjacent custom bar buttons.
statement.ja: 隣接するcustom bar buttonに連続したiPadOS hit regionを作る。

conditions: Prevent the pointer from briefly reverting to its default shape between buttons.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0011.review_note: Recorded adjacency and the distracting default-shape transition it prevents.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0015.title: Keep custom pointer shapes simple

statement.en: Keep custom iPadOS pointer shapes simple and immediately understandable.
statement.ja: custom iPadOS pointer shapeをsimpleで即座に理解できるものにする。

conditions: Signal the available action without drawing excessive attention to the pointer.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0015.review_note: Repaired the statement and recorded action signaling and attention limits.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0017.title: Avoid instructional pointer text

statement.en: Avoid displaying instructional text with an iPadOS pointer.
statement.ja: iPadOS pointerにinstructional textを表示しない。

exceptions: Make the interface clear and simple enough to understand with either pointer or touch.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0017.review_note: Recorded the complexity risk and the interface-clarity alternative.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0018.title: Consider shadow, scale, and spacing together

statement.en: Consider shadow, scale, and element spacing together when defining an iPadOS hover effect.
statement.ja: iPadOS hover effectではshadow、scale、element spacingを合わせて検討する。

conditions: Reserve scaling for elements with room to grow without crowding or overlap.
When space is limited, consider tint without scale and shadow; avoid shadow without scale.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0018.review_note: Retained MAY and preserved all scale, tint, shadow, and spacing relationships.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0019.title: Use highlight for small transparent elements

statement.en: Use the iPadOS highlight effect for a small element with a transparent background.
statement.ja: transparent backgroundを持つsmall elementにはiPadOS highlight effectを使う。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0020.title: Use lift for small opaque elements

statement.en: Use the iPadOS lift effect for a small element with an opaque background.
statement.ja: opaque backgroundを持つsmall elementにはiPadOS lift effectを使う。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0021.title: Use hover for large iPadOS elements

statement.en: Use the iPadOS hover effect for large elements and customize scale, tint, and shadow as needed.
statement.ja: large elementにはiPadOS hover effectを使い、必要に応じてscale、tint、shadowを調整する。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0021.review_note: Repaired the truncated statement and preserved all three customizable attributes.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0022.title: Provide the corner radius for a nonstandard lift shape

statement.en: Provide the corner radius when an iPadOS lift-effect element uses a nonstandard shape.
statement.ja: iPadOS lift effectのelementが非標準shapeを使う場合はcorner radiusを提供する。

conditions: The element’s shape differs from the system rounded rectangle, such as a circle.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0022.review_note: Promoted to MUST after confirming the conditional explicit need to provide the radius for seamless animation.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0023.title: Keep modifier-key results identical across touch and pointer input

statement.en: Ensure a modifier-key interaction produces the same result with touch and pointer input.
statement.ja: modifier-key interactionがtouchとpointer inputで同じ結果になるようにする。

conditions: The app supports the same object interaction with touch and a pointer.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0023.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit ensure requirement as an atomic input-parity rule.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0024.title: Support system iPadOS content effects when possible

statement.en: When possible, support system-provided iPadOS content effects according to each effect’s design intent.
statement.ja: 可能な場合は各effectのdesign intentに従ってsystem提供のiPadOS content effectをsupportする。

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0024.review_note: Recovered the omitted lead and its system-consistency condition.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0025.title: Provide comfortable iPadOS pointer hit regions

statement.en: Provide comfortable pointer hit regions around iPadOS interactive elements.
statement.ja: iPadOSのinteractive element周囲に快適なpointer hit regionを設ける。

conditions: Balance selection precision against the effort needed to pull the pointer away.
About 12 points around bezel elements and 24 points around bezel-free visible edges are documented starting points.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0025.review_note: Recovered the omitted lead and preserved both approximate padding values without making them universal minima.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0026.title: Avoid magnetism on iPadOS hover effects

statement.en: Avoid adding pointer magnetism to an iPadOS element that uses hover.
statement.ja: hoverを使うiPadOS elementにpointer magnetismを追加しない。

conditions: Hover retains the default pointer shape, so magnetism can feel jarring or reduce control.
exceptions: iPadOS applies magnetism by default to lift, highlight, and text-entry areas.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0026.review_note: Recovered the omitted hover-specific restriction and preserved the system-applied exceptions.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0027.title: Support standard macOS pointing-device mappings

statement.en: Support standard macOS mouse and trackpad interactions with their documented behavior.
statement.ja: standard macOS mouse・trackpad interactionを記載されたbehaviorでsupportする。

conditions: Mouse and trackpad: primary click selects; secondary click opens context; scroll moves content; smart zoom and page or full-screen swipes navigate.
Mouse and trackpad: Mission Control activates; trackpad lookup shows data; tap to click performs primary click; force click shows Quick Look or pressure control.
Trackpad pinch zooms; two-finger rotation rotates; edge swipe opens Notification Center; downward swipe opens App Exposé.
Trackpad thumb-and-three-finger pinch opens Launchpad; spreading them reveals the desktop.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0027.review_note: Recovered a specification rule and preserved every interaction, expected behavior, and mouse-versus-trackpad support row.

HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0028.title: Use standard macOS pointer styles by meaning

statement.en: Use each standard macOS pointer style only for its documented interactive meaning.
statement.ja: 各standard macOS pointer styleを記載されたinteractive meaningに合わせて使う。

conditions: Arrow selects; closed or open hand repositions; contextual-menu and pointing-hand pointers indicate menu and link availability.
Crosshair selects precisely; disappearing-item, drag-copy, and drag-link pointers communicate drag results.
Horizontal or vertical I-beam indicates matching text insertion; operation-not-allowed rejects a drop.
Directional resize pointers communicate down, left, left-right, right, up, or up-down resizing.
HIG-INPUTS-POINTING-DEVICES-0028.review_note: Recovered a specification rule and preserved every standard pointer name, meaning, and AppKit mapping.

prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Reviewed input consistency, iPadOS pointer effects and hit regions, macOS tables, and visionOS system behavior; recovered six rules, promoted one explicit need requirement, and refreshed a changed page hash.

review_method: Root reviewed 18 Best practices/iPadOS standard-effect rules and one helper reviewed 10 Customizing pointers/magnetism/macOS rules. Rechecked table mappings, both conditional MUST outcomes, platform-specific examples, alternatives versus exceptions, and explicit pointer/keyboard/touch/gesture retrieval metadata. All 36 prior candidates match exact current DOM hashes and sections. Exact trace presence and semantic approval are separate checks.
unverified: SDK, hardware, force-click support, and OS-version-specific gesture availability were not independently tested.
The current HIG table still names Launchpad; this is retained as page-local source guidance, not a claim about every current macOS version.
General guidance does not establish that every listed input method is available on every platform in its scope.
Source media and former full-page prose were not independently compared or retained.
